description: Hard constraints that must be satisfied by all generated block plans

constraints.name: Train Timetable
constraints.description: Maintenance blocks must not overlap with scheduled train movements

constraints.name: Corridor Availability
constraints.description: Each corridor has defined available windows for maintenance

constraints.name: Block Availability
constraints.description: Only use officially declared block windows

constraints.name: Track Occupancy
constraints.description: No two maintenance activities can occupy the same track simultaneously

constraints.name: Maintenance Duration
constraints.description: Each task must be assigned a block with sufficient duration

constraints.name: Resource Availability
constraints.description: Required personnel and equipment must be available during the block

constraints.name: Safety Requirements
constraints.description: All safety prerequisites must be met before task execution

constraints.name: Isolation Requirements
constraints.description: Tasks requiring power/track isolation cannot overlap with live operations

constraints.name: Task Dependencies
constraints.description: Dependent tasks must be executed in the correct order

constraints.name: Operational Restrictions
constraints.description: Divisional and zone-level operational restrictions must be respected

constraints.name: Safety Conflict
constraints.description: Tasks with conflicting safety requirements cannot share a block

constraints.name: Isolation Exclusivity
constraints.description: At most one isolation-required task per block
